english.meaning: a sound; how a word is pronounced
english.note: 讀錯音 means read a word with the wrong sound.

exampleSentences.english: When we were kids, we always mispronounced “health ed,” reading it as “time.”
exampleSentences.traditional: 我哋細個讀健教成日都讀錯音。即係讀完時間噉解。
